name: shah-agriculture-information-library
description: Shah Agriculture Information Library (Krishi) - full-stack Bengali-first agricultural knowledge platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
